introHtml: Custom 16 oz bar wine gift sets offer a versatile size that works for both hot and cold beverages, making them ideal for year-round corporate gifting. Whether you choose the Hot-N-Cold Gift Set for coffee lovers or the Napa Stemless Wine Tumbler Set for wine enthusiasts, the 16 oz capacity provides a generous serving without being too bulky. These sets are perfect for client appreciation, holiday gifts, or employee recognition programs, and can be decorated with your logo using screen printing or laser engraving.
